people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
translations.bsb: You gave them kingdoms and peoples and allotted to them every corner of the land. So they took the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and of Og king of Bashan.
translations.kjv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
translations.asv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and peoples, which thou didst allot after their portions: so they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
